title: Super Taboo #4 Fantagraphics Books Dec 1995 - Very Good
descriptionText: Super Taboo #4 is a vintage comic book published by Fantagraphics Books in December 1995. Written by Wolf Ogami and featuring the character Taboo, this issue is part of the Super Taboo series. The comic book falls under the genre of mangerotica, with a viewer discretion advised rating. This collectible item, with a modern age era publication, offers a unique and provocative read for fans of US comics and comic book enthusiasts alike.
